newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Hualon says to build T$5 bln nylon plant.
newsitem.headline: Hualon says to build T$5 bln nylon plant.

text.p: Taiwanese textile giant Hualon Corp will invest T$5 billion in a new domestic nylon plant, a company executive said on Thursday.

"The company has in principle decided to invest T$5 billion to build a nylon plant in Taiwan this year as the market demand is rising," the executive, who declined to be identified, said by telephone.
"Outlook for nylon products are very good," the executive said. He said other details were yet to be decided.
The proposed plant would have a daily production capacity of 200 tonnes. Hualon's two existing nylon plants can produce 250 toones of nylon products a day, the executive said.
